facts.text: The Capital Gateway Scholarship provides up to full tuition and fees for Ohio high school seniors with an annual household income of $60,000 or less.

sources.title: First Year Student Scholarships | Capital University, Columbus Ohio
sources.quote: The Capital Gateway Scholarship will bring your total award up to full tuition and fees after other qualifying scholarships, awards, and grants are applied.

sources.title: First Year Student Scholarships | Capital University, Columbus Ohio
sources.quote: Available to current Ohio high school seniors with an annual household income of $60,000 or less who complete the FAFSA annually.
